# FRDM-i.MX95 hardware matrix

Maintainers have this board, so functions can be verified on hardware.

*Profile* is the profile that provides the function: `free`, `full` (needs non-free artifacts) or `blocked`. See [Free vs non-free](FRDM-i.MX95-Free-vs-NonFree).

| Function | Status | Profile | Features | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| audio | implemented-unverified | free | frdm-imx95-audio |  |
| boot | implemented-unverified | full | frdm-imx95-boot-container |  |
| gpu | implemented-unverified | free | frdm-imx95-multimedia |  |
| jpeg | implemented-unverified | free | frdm-imx95-multimedia |  |
| m7-remoteproc | implemented-unverified | full | frdm-imx95-m7-remoteproc |  |
| neutron-npu | implemented-unverified | full | frdm-imx95-neutron-npu |  |
| nvme | implemented-unverified | free | frdm-imx95-nvme |  |
| sd-card | implemented-unverified | free | frdm-imx95-image |  |
| serial-console | implemented-unverified | free | frdm-imx95-core |  |
| wave6-vpu | implemented-unverified | full | frdm-imx95-wave6-vpu |  |
